notes.title: News about the development of GrandMa Badass
notes.content:
[h1]What's next for GrandMa Badass?[/h1]

[b]The point at September 3, 2022[/b]

Knowing that many of you have already played GrandMa Badass episode 1 and 2 when these 2 opuses were offered for sale individually, you will then be interested to find out a little more about what's in store for you and what stage the development of this point and click is at.

[h2]What will happen first when GrandMa Badass is released?[/h2]
If you're a lucky purchaser of Episode 1, who trusted the project when it was released and didn't delete it, then you'll simply be thanked by automatically getting an update to the FULL game, over Episode 1.

[This means that for the price of one episode, you will get the full game. [/b](which should be sold 19.99 €)

[h2]Where is the project at this time, early September?[/h2]
The game follows its development course and as of September 3, is therefore at the stage of the end of design of episode 4.
As a reminder, there are 5 episodes planned.

[h2]Do we have an idea of the release date of the complete game?[/h2]
The release date is estimated for the end of the last quarter of 2022.
Due to the very large number of releases in November, it is likely that the game will be released for December 2022.
But also, depending on the status, maybe earlier, for October. Today, nothing is certain yet, the priority being to offer you a complete game, which makes you go through all the states of mind and will captivate you at least 8 hours...

[h2]Any news about the game since the release of episode 2?[/h2]
You will have to start the game from scratch because the whole system has changed and the saves will not be operational anymore.

-A new gameplay with the optional display of the preference bar and the inventory during the game. (the game in 16/9 will display the GUI inventory and preference only when you move the mouse pointer to the top or bottom of the screen)

-A playful help system with the display of important objects with a simple press of the "Space" key

-New screens for functionalities (saving, loading, configuration etc)

-A sound mixer to manage each sound channel (sound effects, music, ambient sounds etc.)

-More Steam hits to discover, including some very rare ones.

Thanks to you and don't forget to add GrandMa Badass to your wishlist so you don't miss its release if you don't have episode 1 (released in May 2021) in your Steam library yet!

notes.title: GrandMa Badass Episode 2 (DLC) is available !
notes.content:
[h1]GRANDMA BADASS EPISODE 2: CONCRETE TRAP [/h1]
[img]https://i0.wp.com/adipson-studio.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/affiche-episode2-1.jpg?resize=724%2C1024&ssl=1[/img]
[h2]Episode 2 of GrandMa Badass has been available since Tuesday, September 14, 2021 on the Steam store.[/h2]

A new adventure that plunges you into a bunker, a kind of concrete prison, filled with puzzles and in which GrandMa Badass will have to solve puzzles to progress until the exit ...

Go to [url=https: //store.steampowered.com/app/1746000/Grandma_Badass__episode_2/] https://store.steampowered.com/app/1746000/Grandma_Badass__episode_2/[/url] for more information or download your DLC!
____________________________________
Please note, you must have episode 1 to be able to play the DLC, even if the latter starts independently of this episode 1.

notes.title: Thanks to the Steam gaming community for their support on GrandMa!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40370032/52cf00c59c926524b63d45a0de830818aa3f1f28.jpg[/img]
[h1]Tomorrow is the big D-Day for GrandMa which will open up to new players on Steam! [/h1]

[h2]The game is all set for this big day and it has improved a lot in the space of a few days ... and all thanks to this friendly community of players on Steam![/h2]

What was supposed to be a final version, filed online 15 days ago, has turned into a real beta game.
It was not expected, but many players had fun in the game, and small minor bugs were also reported which were therefore gradually fixed in the game to provide even more enjoyable gameplay.

Better yet, the game can now enjoy [b] a perfect functioning of Steam Achievement [/ b] thanks to this community and more particularly to players that I will come back to below.
I've never been told enough: [i]"gamers love Steam Achievements"[/i] ...

So I want to thank all the players who have received a key for GrandMa Badass, who have played and given me feedback on their gaming experience, bug feedback, and in fact provided invaluable and incredible help for it. do what it is now, on May 4, 2021, the day before its release ...

[h3]I only discovered this community of players a few days ago. And they were so benevolent that I cannot conclude this little message by quoting a few of them and I apologize if I forgot any in the process, there were so many of you !!![/h3]

The first one I will logically thank is the player [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/hoexyr/][b]Fenryl[/b][/url] !
He was one of the very first to play the game, knew all the versions, knows the game by heart (maybe even sooner better than I who designed it lol) [u]and especially connected my little notebook to totally empty address with most of the French-speaking players who played and participated in the improvement of GrandMa Badass.[/u]

The second person was introduced to me by [b]Fenryl[/b] and [u]you actually owe him the ability to unlock achievements on Steam : [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Peace1sWar/][b]PeaceisWar[/b][/url]
Stuck on a synchronization issue between the game and the Steam platform for several days, he managed to give me a tip that allowed me to finally be able to make GrandMa compatible with the achievements.

But that's not all ... he also took his time to [u][b] do all the English translation[/b][/u] of the game !!!!
I never imagined I could enjoy so much benevolence from players who barely discover me, in any way, today with this game.
[i](I'm even sure he'll definitely have me correct some translation errors on the English version of this ad ... lol)[/i]

And finally, I can only thank for their patience in playing, testing, replaying, retesting the game over the versions, the players of what I will call the community of point and click players, largely presented yet again. times by Fenryl ...

So a big thank you to him and to those players (many of them female) like [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/capabiIity/][b]Capability[/b][/url], [url=https ://steamcommunity.com/id/kamikaze62260/][b]Kamikaze69[/b][/url], [url=https: //steamcommunity.com/id/Clovinoux/][b] Clovinoux[/b] [/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Bebeluga/] [b]Emperor Ti Pet[/b] [/url].

Many thanks to all the players who spent time on this game and even discovered my very first (3 Geeks), and gave me amazing feedback, and provided great help with their comments like those of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198036328736/][b]karakatapakatapa[/b][/url] or again and always PieceisWar with whom I have spent more time in recent hours than with Mimine, my cat, which makes me the face because too busy on the keyboard since these days which precede the exit!

So thank you to the first players who made or will perhaps write a review on the page that I hope is pretty cool:
[list]
[*] siljeeg
[*] McCoy
[*] Wakkun
[*] Emylia
[*] Oxdorado
[*] julimo59
[*] Jen
[*] Redd
[*] Lucky Shot
[*] LBEO | Gryphon [FR]
[*] CrazyPyro69
[*] maitrelikao
[*] Wil
[*] Yazorius
[/list]
Thank you all and now, long life to GrandMa and above all ... see you for episode 2, hoping that episode 1 appeals to a large number of players to always motivate me to work even harder on the sequel to this episodic game ...

May GrandMa Badass live a long time, good game everyone and thank you in advance for your opinions, reviews (even negative), reviews, lives etc of GrandMa Badass which should start soon enough as soon as the game is launched!
